title: PCG-MAS Pre-Registered Benchmark Sample Size Protocol

calibration_pilot_sample.isolation_guarantee: ZERO_CONTAMINATION: Observations from the calibration partition are strictly forbidden from entering final manuscript evaluation statistics.

sample_size_formula.finite_population_correction: N_adj = N / (1 + (N - 1) / N_pop) when evaluating against finite benchmark splits

missing_and_invalid_responses.handling: Timeouts, rate-limit drops, and schema-invalid outputs are scored as uncertified / verification failures, not pruned or replaced.

budget_ceiling_and_fallback.budget_exhaustion_fallback: If the required N for delta=0.05 exceeds budget ceiling, N is truncated to max affordable budget with pre-declared wider confidence interval reporting.
